groups.rationale: Catch-all sources: susan/ gains the WNS provider (Entra ID client credentials, raw notifications, channel URIs admitted only under susan-wns-channel-shape, provider code 3, wns_app_ids and WNS_* secrets); mila/ gains macOS and Windows runners, darwin/Shared Swift, platform profile, Windows owner-only DACL storage and mila/tool. Chapters 08, 11, 20, 21 and 22 updated; the WNS path is undeployed and its gaps are named in 20-security and the susan-wns-egress scenario.

Marshall device registration accepts macos and windows platforms (Notifications.Device, ssh device register, device_registered event enum); chapter 08 Mila now documents desktop platforms, custody, owner-only DACLs, WNS registration and the dev/release build targets; 20-security and 21-domains name WNS; scenarios mila-desktop-custody, mila-build-release-targets and susan-wns-egress added with present-only evidence.

OverallsProtocol.SSHCommand device register --platform accepts ios, android, macos and windows with linux still refused; chapter 08 Mila notifications records the four platform wire values and the desktop push paths.

No lilly/ source changes; its shared chapters 19-coverage and 20-security changed only for Mila desktop custody, build targets and Susan WNS egress, none of which alters provisioning, storage, network or guest behaviour.

No audi/brady/ziggy/galileo/enrico/porsche/lyra/peach source changes; shared chapters 08, 11, 19, 20, 21 and 22 changed only for Mila desktop clients and Susan WNS. Porsche device commands are unchanged; platform admission lives in the protocol library.

Reviewed: the SCIM machine probe now follows the existing unauthenticated Control Room redirect before matching localized English and Arabic responses; deployed topology, options and documented SCIM behavior are unchanged.

No docs/, scripts/, .agents/ or CONTRACTS source changes; shared chapters 19-22 changed only for Mila desktop, build targets and Susan WNS. ADR-0235/0236 are referenced and not yet written; no governance rule changes.
